input.kind: synthetic agent-era repository generated by demo/seed.sh
input.note: the seed is deterministic (fixed content and timestamps), so this fold reproduces exactly on any machine

steps.summary: self-contained foldable timeline written by histfold fold; expand/collapse runs on inline vanilla JS

limitations: v0.1 reads Claude Code session logs only; other agent runtimes fold on trailers and time gaps at lower confidence
folding is single-player by design: it correlates session logs found on the local machine
macOS and Linux only; no Windows builds in v0.1
histfold is strictly read-only: it never mutates git history or the working tree
